'''''Jedi Search''''' is a [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] novel written by [[Kevin J. Anderson]]. It is the first volume of ''[[Star Wars: The Jedi Academy Trilogy]]'', and it was first published in paperback by [[Bantam Spectra]] in [[March]] [[1994]]. A sequel, [[Dark Apprentice (novel)|''Dark Apprentice'']], was published later that year.
